purpose: The one shared prose container. All element typography comes from .marketing-rich-text.

unsupportedElements.reason: The original ships NO rules for either and neither appears on any sampled page. RichTextBlocks refuses them rather than rendering raw UA defaults.

maxWordsBasis: recomputed over every richtext section heading and paragraph on all 102 detail routes
states: No hover, no active, no focus, no transition, no box-shadow.
criticalRules: The container's own font-size is the ROOT em (10.6667px @1280), NOT the paragraph size. `figure`/`figcaption` therefore resolve 1em to ~10.67px and the caption is genuinely tiny. That is correct; do not fix it.
`.marketing-rich-text h2` is line-height 1.2. The standalone display h2 (components/block.content-heading) is 1.48. Both are 48px at 1280. THEY ARE TWO SEPARATE ROLES AND MUST NOT BE UNIFIED.
Nothing in this component may set a font-size.
